result:
Iteration 4 is complete. `review_loop/verdict_04.json` is valid against the schema with `gold_standard_met: false` (real flaws were found and fixed, so the loop runs again per the charter).

**TLDR — what this pass found and changed, before any GPU spend:**

**The central finding (design, not code):** the spec's §0 calls the headline "a diversity claim, not a leaderboard claim," yet R6.5's only pre-registered confirmatory endpoint was the *coverage* gain — the diversity half of the thesis had no confirmatory test at all. Worse, I derived that the coverage endpoint was predictably power-doomed: the exact sign-flip test has a hard tie-imposed floor p ≥ 2^(1+z−n), so at n=10 it cannot reach p<0.05 unless ≥6 instances show a nonzero same-direction gain — and 0/1 coverage gains on easy instances will tie constantly. **Fix:** R6.5 is now a fixed-sequence confirmatory family — H1 = rarefied distinct-patch gain at matched k\* (the title claim, near-continuous, rarely ties), then H2 = coverage gain tested only if H1 rejects. FWER stays at 0.05, the coverage bar went *up*, and `min_achievable_p` is now reported beside every p-value so a null can never be misread as "no effect" when it's just ties.

**A genuine numerical bug:** the post-hoc τ sweep trusted the 3-decimal `Entropy:` log line, which rounds across gate boundaries at exactly the grid τ values it sweeps — partition (2,2,1) of 5 is 1.054920, logged as 1.055 > 1.0549, so the sweep branched where a real run gates (one existing test had even pinned the wrong semantics). The sweep now recomputes entropy *exactly* from the logged cluster partition, with a flagged fallback that never "corrects" kernel runs, plus a regression test on the boundary.

**Also fixed:** realized N is now measured per instance (the proposer can return <5 strategies, silently breaking quantization comparability — previously an unverified premise); the tracer's hardcoded `temperature: 1.0` misrecording; duplicate-row inflation from re-running the append-mode resample driver; the majority-signature selector's degeneracy on the branching arm (all-distinct patches → pure tie-break) is now measured and disclosed; per-arm rarefied diversity levels added so the results table is actually computable; and a stale "no figure script" doc claim corrected.

All verified without GPU runs: 69 tests pass (was 63), py_compile clean, both analysis scripts re-run end-to-end on the real `results/branching` artifacts. The two spec amendments (with rationale, rejected alternatives, and the hostile read answered) await the independent critic and human ratification — that ratification should land **before** the GPU runs so the new confirmatory family can't be accused of data-contingency.
